Packet evidence excerpts were truncated, so the full tool outputs were read from the transcript jsonl (read-only) to confirm what the assistant saw. Live repo checks were read-only greps/reads in cwd; the worktree HEAD (f7298d5, 2026-08-27) predates the session and no guidance files changed since, so current state equals session-time state. External Chrome-docs claims were checked against the in-session search output and by read-only curl/WebFetch of the cited developer.chrome.com pages. Chrome's docs use document.modelContext (W3C community docs use navigator.modelContext), so that API name is graded supported. Hypothetical examples ('such as open_stack_settings'), recommendations and plan statements were not extracted.
